OAuth creates attributable dedicated users and role links. Private isolated Basic and non-admin-cookie credentials; rejected renewal, expiry, account mismatch, permissions and auth-sensitive workflows; no admin elevation to hide ACL failure.

Create owned item, variables and dependent flow; order with variables; independently verify request/RITM and actual fulfillment outcome. An existing-item order or accepted submission alone is incomplete.

Use isolated HOME/XDG/workspace and controlled external-service/npm fixtures. Test setup/config persistence, cancellation, docs source modes, skill destination/content freshness, completion dispatch, history privacy/pruning, upgrade behavior and saved snippet round-trip. Never upgrade the real installation.
Explicit read-only target, bounded reads, no eval or instance mutation; normal OAuth/session refresh allowed. These paths illustrate the lane, not an allowlist or proof of every read.
Actual before/after capture IDs, source/binary provenance, monotonic per-test timing and observed domain-separation traits or unknown. Non-gating; public sanitized projection, raw private evidence.

contract.binding: Join actual scenario.commandPaths to canonical entries. Unknown command paths or test references are errors. scenarioIds remain empty until runner integration binds real exported scenarios.

contract.requirements: entries[].acceptance.requirements plus each effectiveOptions name are required bindings. Shared scenarios may bind multiple paths/options with explicit assertions.

contract.mutation: declaredMutation copies actual mutation guard, not a claim of HTTP/read-only semantics. noInstance is a middleware capability, not a guarantee of local-only behavior.
